audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 4 and 6 disagreed with the already-written riven__yorick mirror, which sets Levels 4-5 and Level 6 to Riven and two-plus items to Yorick. whys[3] additionally described level 6 while sitting in the Levels 4-5 row.
audit.why: Levels 4-5 are not even — Ki Burst is back every 9s at rank 3 and Valor shields the exit, so Riven picks every trade. Level 6 adds Blade of the Exile at 120s with bonus damage, extra range and a Wind Slash. Two-plus items flips to Yorick because Riven has to be present to duel and Maiden does not.
audit.corrected: win[3]/phases[3].side and win[4]/phases[4].side to Riven, win[6]/phases[6].side to Yorick as one paired group, ratings 3/3/6 on those rows. whys[3], whys[4], whys[5] and whys[6] rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the matchup 'never names any of Riven's abilities'. Every spike referred to 'her Q', 'her dashes', 'her R burst' with no names and no cooldowns.
audit.why: Broken Wings is a flat 13s with three casts, the third knocking back; Ki Burst is 11/10/9/8/7s at 260 range; Valor is 10/9/8/7/6s at 250 with the shield; Blade of the Exile is 120/90/60s and grants one Wind Slash. Counting her three Broken Wings casts is the actual skill of the matchup, and that is unteachable without the name and the 13s.
audit.corrected: All four abilities named with real cooldowns across spikes[0..3].text, early, mid, late, phases[1].why, phases[3].why, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields tell the player Riven dashes over Dark Procession: whys[5], spikes[0].text, spikes[2].text, early and wants.foe[1].
audit.why: Riot's Dark Procession text is a destructible wall that 'will block enemy movement', and the kit file's terrain flag reads 'blocks paths and dashes'. Valor is Riot-described as 'Riven steps forward a short distance' — 250 range — and Broken Wings is a short lash, both of which the wall stops. So the cage is the correct answer to her mobility rather than a spell she ignores, and telling a player otherwise removes their only lane tool. What she genuinely beats is the swarm in open ground, which is why the side-lane corridor is the place to fight her.
audit.corrected: All five fields rewritten so the wall blocks Valor. wants.you[1] ('Cage her against a wall to deny dashes') was already correct and is kept.

audit.why: Wind Slash is one ranged projectile per Blade of the Exile activation, per Riot's text — worth stating so the player does not expect repeated ranged pokes during her ultimate. Added to spikes[1].text.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now names Wind Slash as a single use.
